decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the core postpress portfolio, still has its own product page, and fits established sales and service routines, so there is no clear shortfall against aspirations that would call for search for other uses of its resources.

The UV spot varnishing system is distant from the core offer and its results remain uncertain, but as a flagship with a German premiere, and with slack from growing industry turnover, the firm can carry it longer to build a track record, even though the 2024 pruning shows management is willing to cut.
The B2 multifinisher is a home-page flagship close to the core business and aligned with the move toward automated workflows, so it most likely meets aspirations and gives no reason to drop it.
